# uptimekuma_notification_smtp (Resource)

SMTP notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_smtp" "example" {
  name = "SMTP Notifications"

  # Required fields
  host = "smtp.example.com"
  from = "uptime-kuma@example.com"
  to   = "admin@example.com"

  # Optional: SMTP server configuration
  port             = 587
  secure           = true
  ignore_tls_error = false

  # Optional: SMTP authentication
  username = "smtp-user"
  password = "smtp-password"

  # Optional: Additional recipients
  cc  = "supervisor@example.com"
  bcc = "archive@example.com"

  # Optional: Email customization
  custom_subject = "Alert from Uptime Kuma"
  custom_body    = "Service {{ serviceName }} is {{ status }}"
  html_body      = false

  # Optional: Additional mail headers
  additional_headers = jsonencode({
    "X-Custom-Header" = "Additional Header"
    "X-Environment"   = "production"
  })

  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_smtp" "with_dkim" {
  name = "SMTP with DKIM"

  host = "smtp.example.com"
  port = 587
  from = "monitoring@example.com"
  to   = "alerts@example.com"

  username = "smtp-user"
  password = "smtp-password"

  # Optional: DKIM signing for authentication
  dkim_domain             = "example.com"
  dkim_key_selector       = "default"
  dkim_private_key        = "-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----\n...\n-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----"
  dkim_hash_algo          = "sha256"
  dkim_header_field_names = "From:Subject:Date"
  dkim_skip_fields        = "Bcc"

  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: password_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change password_wo_version whenever the password changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_smtp" "write_only_password" {
  name = "SMTP with a write-only password"

  host = "smtp.example.com"
  port = 587
  from = "monitoring@example.com"
  to   = "alerts@example.com"

  username            = "smtp-user"
  password_wo         = "smtp-password"
  password_wo_version = "1"

  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from` (String) Sender email address
- `host` (String) SMTP server hostname
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `to` (String) Recipient email addresses (comma-separated)

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `additional_headers` (String) Extra headers to merge into the headers of every mail Uptime Kuma sends through this notification, given as a JSON object encoded in a string, for example `jsonencode({ "X-Custom-Header" = "Additional Header" })`. A value that is not a JSON object is rejected while it is known at plan time; a value still unknown then reaches the server unchecked. Omitting the attribute adds no headers and clears any value stored on the notification at the next apply.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `bcc` (String) BCC email addresses (comma-separated)
- `cc` (String) CC email addresses (comma-separated)
- `custom_body` (String) Custom email body
- `custom_subject` (String) Custom email subject
- `dkim_domain` (String) DKIM domain for email signing
- `dkim_hash_algo` (String) DKIM hash algorithm (sha1, sha256)
- `dkim_header_field_names` (String) DKIM header field names to sign
- `dkim_key_selector` (String) DKIM key selector
- `dkim_private_key` (String, Sensitive) DKIM private key for email signing
- `dkim_skip_fields` (String) DKIM fields to skip
- `html_body` (Boolean) Enable HTML formatting in email body
- `ignore_tls_error` (Boolean) Ignore TLS certificate errors
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP password for authentication. Stored in state; use `password_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SMTP password for authentication, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `password`; requires `password_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `password_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `password` until the next apply with `password_wo` set removes it from state.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `password_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `password_wo`.
- `port` (Number) SMTP server port
- `secure` (Boolean) Enable TLS/SSL for SMTP connection
- `username` (String) SMTP username for authentication

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
